verses.1: The ancients tried to make them submit to their authorities, so that they would be worthy of any good work.
verses.2: Do not be disrespectful; be brave and intelligent. Show kindness to everyone around you.
verses.3: For sometimes we too were foolish, wicked, deluded, and worked according to various desires and pleasures. We led a life of evil and hatred, hating each other.
verses.4: And when the usefulness and kindness of our savior, God, became apparent,
verses.5: He did not save us through the works of justice that we had carried out; instead, he saved us through his own mercy. This was done by the power of the Holy Spirit, a force of renewal and restoration.
verses.6: By Jesus Christ, our Savior, who has brought us great wealth.
verses.7: So that we may become heirs to his grace, in the hope of having a long life.
verses.8: It’s a trustworthy statement. I hope that you will be convinced by these words, so that those who have come to believe in God may be able to engage in good deeds. This is indeed good and beneficial for people.
verses.9: However, there are also those who ask for things related to age, gender, and legal disputes. Some of these requests are beneficial, while others are not.
verses.10: A person who is arbitrary can be dismissed after one or two warnings.
verses.11: You know that such a person is destroyed and commits sin, being self-reproachful.
verses.12: When I send Arteminus to you or Tuchikon, then go to me in Nikopol. There, you will be able to receive your reward.
verses.13: We should also pay close attention to the legal aspects, so that nothing is missed by them.
verses.14: They also failed to prepare ourselves for the necessary expenses, so that we wouldn’t be in a difficult situation when it came time to pay them.
verses.15: May you be protected by those who are with me. May those who love us be protected in their faith. May the grace be with you all.
